items.action: Build the consumer immediately after the bump — the compiler enumerates every collision. Per member: keep the name and add `override` with a base-compatible signature where the base means the same thing, otherwise rename your own member. TableComponent gained the inputs `total`, `sortingOrder`, `animateHeight`, `scrollToTopOnPageChange` and the private method `parseDurationMs`.
items.appliesWhen: Only a consumer that EXTENDS a DS component class. Subclassing is unsupported; anyone using the DS elements is unaffected.
items.pitfall: It is not only the table this time — most component classes changed, so fixing the collisions the compiler names first can still leave others in files it has not reached. Check any renamed member against the base member list before settling on the new name.
items.note: A subclass that already used one of the added names stops compiling: TS4114 wants an `override` modifier, TS2416 fires where the signature differs. `TableComponent` gained `total`, `sortingOrder`, `animateHeight`, `scrollToTopOnPageChange` and `parseDurationMs`, and lost `resizeState`. `AutocompleteComponent`, `CheckboxComponent`, `ColorPickerComponent`, `DatePickerComponent`, `MultiSelectComponent`, `OtpInputComponent`, `RadioComponent`, `RadioGroupComponent`, `SelectComponent`, `SliderComponent`, `SwitchComponent`, `TextareaComponent` and `TimePickerComponent` each gained `reserveMessage`. `AvatarComponent` gained `avoidHues` and `seed`. `BadgeComponent` gained `countLabel`. `BottomSheetComponent` gained `scrollLock` and lost `previousBodyOverflow`. `DrawerComponent` and `ModalComponent` each gained `scrollLock` and lost `doc`. `InputComponent` gained `reserveMessage` and lost `withAddon` and `withAddonRight`. `PaginationComponent` lost `pageChange` and `pageSizeChange`. `SearchComponent` gained `size`. `SidenavItemComponent` gained `activate` and `onActivate`. `TooltipDirective` gained `disposeRef`. `AppLayoutComponent` (the renamed `AppShellComponent`) gained `layoutScroll` and lost `shellScroll`.
items.verify: A typecheck reports no TS4114 / TS2416 / TS2415 on a subclass of a class in `detect`.

informational: Fourteen per-component size types collapsed into one shared `DsSize` (`sm | md | lg`) exported from the package root - IconButtonSize, ButtonSize, InputSize, SelectSize, CheckboxSize, RadioSize, SwitchSize, SpinnerSize, TextareaSize, NumberStepperSize, DatePickerSize, TimePickerSize, DrawerSize and AutocompleteSize. Each has its own item above. After the renames a file that imported several of them holds several identical `DsSize` imports; collapse them.

AvatarSize, ModalSize and ContainerSize are NOT removed — they remain and now extend DsSize ('xs' | DsSize, DsSize | 'xl' | 'fullscreen', DsSize | 'xl' | 'full'); no change needed for consumers using those three.

ds-avatar gains deterministic seeded tinting: [seed]/[avoidHues] inputs derive a stable per-person OKLCH background + auto-contrast text; standalone exports avatarTint(seed, options), AvatarTintOptions and initialsFrom(first, last) (also accepts a full-name string) — additive, off by default, no code change.

New override tokens --ds-sidenav-item-label-weight and --ds-modal-title-weight (previously baked into font: shorthands); defaults unchanged (--font-weight-semibold / --font-weight-bold) — additive, no code change.

ds-table gains opt-in inputs total (server-side paging: feed the full row count and pass one pre-sliced page), sortingOrder (e.g. ['asc','desc'] to drop the unsorted state), animateHeight (tween body height on a row-set change), scrollToTopOnPageChange, plus TableColumn.srLabel (visually-hidden header name) — all additive, off by default, no code change.
ds-search gains a size input (sm/md/lg); default md keeps the prior 36px height, so existing consumers are unaffected — additive, no code change.
ds-badge gains a countLabel input (default 'notifications') for the count's accessible-label noun — additive, no code change.

Bugfixes, no code change: --ds-avatar-size now applies at every size (not only md); ds-table clamps an out-of-range page after a client-side filter shrinks the result set; collapsed ds-sidenav no longer overflows by 1px; dsTooltip now listens on focusin/focusout so keyboard focus toggles the tip and re-rendered anchors no longer strand panels; stacked overlays (modal/drawer/bottom-sheet) no longer unlock body scroll under each other (shared ref-counted BodyScrollLockService).

ds-sidenav-item gains an optional (activate) output — emits the click MouseEvent; preventDefault() intercepts navigation on an href item, but a routerLink item navigates regardless. Additive, no code change.
BodyScrollLockService is now a public export — inject it to make a consumer's own full-screen overlay share the DS body-scroll lock (paired lock()/unlock()). Additive, no code change.

ds-menu: a disabled ds-menu-item is now keyboard-focusable (aria-disabled, kept in the roving/arrow/type-ahead order) instead of being dropped from nav and rendered as a native disabled button; activation stays blocked and a [dsTooltip] on it now shows on focus. Behavior/a11y only, no code change — but an e2e/unit test asserting a disabled menu item is unfocusable/native-disabled must be updated.
